basic_info.description: Reduced!  Top Floor, Beautiful Loft Condo, Remodeled 1 bedroom, 2 full baths in a Boutique Building in Dogpatch. Main level has large living room with soaring ceilings, floor to ceiling windows with automatic remote controlled window shades, ceiling fan and gas burning fireplace.  Kitchen has new quartz countertops, new stainless sinks, stainless appliances and breakfast bar.  Full updated bath on lower level as well.  Upper loft level has large ensuite bedroom with 2nd full updated bath and huge closet space.  Property has Eastern Exposure and includes air conditioning unit.  Hardwood floors on both levels and in-unit washer/dryer. 1 Car deeded parking, best parking spot in the building!   Additional storage at parking spot. Amenities include shared roof deck and elevator.  Close to Chase Center, Oracle Park, Crane Cove Park, Waterfront Bike Trail, Muni T-Line, 280/101/80 Freeway Access, UCSF, Restaurants, Cafes, and many other conveniences.   Best Weather in Town!
